controls.label: Surface and membership
controls.data: Current owner/copy label, stable surface, native floor, source grid, lock; selected mark layer and group membership.
controls.wire: Read-only retained Host projection; MarkTarget/Layer/Mark fields are unchanged.
controls.limits: One supported existing rectangle top. Never use transient cell/triangle indices.

controls.label: Chosen artwork revision
controls.data: Artwork label plus rN for the active choice and selected mark; full Pin only in value/title/Technical details.
controls.wire: graphic.artwork is the exact id/revision/contentDigest Pin.
controls.limits: No follow-latest, automatic pin replacement or hash reconstruction. Thumbnails borrow verified Host resources.

controls.label: Ordered layers
controls.data: Layer label/order, opacity, derived visibility and mark count; add/up/down/remove.
controls.wire: surface.layers carries exact target, complete after-list and removedLayerMarkIds.
controls.limits: Up to8 distinct IDs/orders 0..7. Empty label allowed <=120 code points. Preserve unedited fields/order; no normalization on load.

controls.label: Opacity and visibility
controls.data: Layer/mark opacity 0..1 with status such as Hidden: layer opacity is 0%. Actual clipping/view visibility is Host-reported.
controls.wire: Layer.opacity and Graphic.opacity; persisted Layer has no visible field.
controls.limits: Visibility is a derived state in this first plan. Changing opacity is explicit. No hidden previous-opacity store, fabricated eye-toggle field or budget refund.

controls.label: Stamp / Repeat detail
controls.data: Two supported forms and their sampling meaning.
controls.wire: stamp/clamp or detail/repeat; never independent mismatched form/wrap choices.
controls.limits: Stamp outside-frame transparent; repeat stays inside its finite frame. Unsupported sampler/profile refuses.

controls.label: Pose and pivot
controls.data: Local U/V metres, positive width/height, edited angle, mirrorU, image-top-left pivot U/V; numeric alternatives for gestures.
controls.wire: decoration.update replaces the full same-ID next-revision Mark, preserving target and unedited Graphic values.
controls.limits: Exact C0 size 0.000001..100000 m, position +/-1000000 m, rotation -pi..pi and pivot 0..1, subject to tighter captured Host limits. Preserve raw unedited radians; convert displayed degrees only when edited. No automatic readable-text flip.

controls.label: Tint and mask
controls.data: Explicit linear RGB components and either whole surface or source-grid selection.
controls.wire: Graphic.tintLinearRGB and all-surface or exact grid-spans mask.
controls.limits: Host/Core supplies grid id/version/digest and canonical spans, max4096 cells; empty selection is not whole-surface. No implicit sRGB conversion.

controls.label: Mark membership / erase
controls.data: Selected layer, stable mark identity/order and ungrouped status; explicit layer reassignment or erase.
controls.wire: decoration.add/update/remove; full replacement preserves target; expectedRevision on update only; groupPolicy preserve-whole-group.
controls.limits: groupId null. Group membership is readable; grouped source makes this Stage A appearance route unavailable. No detach/reanchor/cross-owner move.

controls.label: Stage / Review / Apply
controls.data: Draft, preparing artwork, real review ready, saved, view-needs-attention, unknown-result statuses.
controls.wire: Same retained seven-method service, exact canonical packet/Expected and retained Apply request.
controls.limits: Construct once; same post-construction/stale/service fences. Plan2 committable:false is not Review readiness. Unknown freezes mutations and overwrite saves; original-ID recovery.

controls.label: Technical details
controls.data: Collapsed exact pins/IDs, source/profile/capture observations, action diagnostics/readiness, costs and retained command/checkpoint.
controls.wire: Read-only projection plus existing borrowed whole-document save/open hooks.
controls.limits: One current/attempted error surface. Contextual disabled-control reasons; no global unavailable-feature catalogue or raw unbound table in normal flow.
